button.label: Toggle Data Labels
button.supertip: Cycle data labels: none → outside end → inside centre. Applies to selected series or all series.

button.label: Toggle Gridlines
button.supertip: Cycle gridlines on the selected chart: none → horizontal → vertical → both.

button.label: Toggle Axis Labels
button.supertip: Cycle axis tick labels on the selected chart: none → x-axis → y-axis → both.

button.label: Toggle Legend
button.supertip: Toggle the chart legend on or off and resize the plot area to match.

button.label: Chart Export
button.supertip: Export chart as PNG, GIF, JPG, BMP, SVG, or PDF. Note that this will *not* warn you to overwrite an existing file.
